properties.title: Court Partially Dismisses Neapco's Claims Against AAM

properties.title: Tentative Agreement Reached After Prolonged Strike at American Axle Plant
properties.summary: After a tense 10-day strike by unionized workers at an American Axle plant in Michigan, a tentative agreement has been reached that proposes a significant wage increase. The new contract suggests a maximum hourly wage of $30 through 2030, marking a 36% increase over four years, pending ratification by union members.

properties.title: Worker Takes a Stand on the Picket Line
properties.summary: River Wilson, a dedicated worker impacted by the ongoing strike, has been actively participating in the picket line as negotiations between American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings and its employees have stalled. Her commitment highlights the personal stakes involved in the labor dispute.
properties.subcategory: Freedom Of Association And Collective Bargaining

properties.title: Dispute Over Surveillance Proposal at American Axle Plant
properties.summary: Jager criticized Dauch's recent proposal for surveillance cameras at the American Axle plant, claiming it ignored prior agreements about the use of video footage. He expressed frustration that discussions were being disregarded, emphasizing that both parties had previously consented to limit video usage to serious misconduct cases.

properties.title: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed Joins American Axle Workers on Picket Line
properties.summary: UAW-endorsed U.S. Senate candidate Dr. Abdul El-Sayed made headlines by joining American Axle workers on the picket line in Three Rivers, MI. His presence not only highlighted the ongoing labor dispute but also amplified the workers' call for a $30 minimum wage by 2030, drawing national attention to their cause.

properties.title: Nexteer Workers Organize Against Union Leadership
properties.summary: Workers at the Saginaw steering plant have overwhelmingly rejected four tentative agreements proposed by union leadership, leading to a significant vote authorizing a strike. An online meeting hosted by the International Workers Alliance of Rank-and-File Committees aims to rally support for the workers, who are frustrated with the UAW's refusal to consult them and the declaration of strike action as 'illegal'. This situation reflects a growing movement among auto parts workers to resist concessions and demand fair treatment.
properties.subcategory: Freedom Of Association And Collective Bargaining, Working Conditions

properties.title: American Axle Strike Enters Second Day
properties.summary: The ongoing strike at American Axle in Three Rivers has entered its second day, with hundreds of workers walking off the job. This labor action could significantly impact the production of truck axles, potentially disrupting the manufacturing of popular models such as the Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra.

properties.title: Senator Camilleri Backs UAW 2093 Workers' Demands
properties.summary: In a recent statement, Senator Darrin Camilleri has expressed his support for the workers of UAW 2093 at American Axle Manufacturing. As the expiration of their current contract approaches, he stands firmly behind their calls for better wages and benefits.

properties.title: UAW Members at American Axle to Vote on Strike Authorization
properties.summary: UAW Local 2093 members at American Axle in Michigan are set to vote on May 11 regarding a strike authorization, which could lead to a walkout starting May 31 if approved. This decision comes amid ongoing frustrations over wage cuts and demands for better compensation and job security, despite the company's significant profits and executive pay.

properties.title: UAW Launches Campaign for Record Contract Amidst Profit Disparity
properties.summary: UAW President Shawn Fain will join American Axle workers at a rally in Three Rivers to kick off a campaign for a record contract, highlighting the stark contrast between the company's $2.9 billion profits and the significant wage cuts endured by employees. As negotiations approach, the rally aims to galvanize union members and build momentum following recent successful strikes, emphasizing the ongoing struggle for fair compensation.
properties.subcategory: Freedom Of Association And Collective Bargaining, Working Conditions

properties.title: UAW Local 2093 Releases Video Demanding Fair Wages Ahead of Contract Expiration
properties.summary: UAW Local 2093 members at American Axle have released a new video outlining their demands for fair wages and benefits as their contract approaches expiration on May 31. The video emphasizes the ongoing struggles of workers who have endured significant concessions since 2008, contrasting their sacrifices with the company's recent profitability and high executive compensation. This public statement marks a renewed push for equitable treatment and highlights the urgency of their demands.

properties.title: Fire Disrupts Operations at Three Rivers American Axle Plant
properties.summary: A fire broke out on the roof of the Three Rivers American Axle manufacturing plant early Thursday morning, leading to a temporary shutdown of operations. Firefighters quickly extinguished the blaze, and while no injuries were reported, a small area of the plant was affected by water runoff from firefighting efforts. The cause of the fire remains under investigation.

properties.title: Jessica LaRoque Files Race-Based Discrimination Lawsuit Against American Axle
properties.summary: A civil rights employment-discrimination lawsuit has been initiated by Jessica LaRoque against American Axle & Manufacturing, Inc. in Michigan, alleging race-based discrimination in hiring practices. The case, filed in the U.S. District Court, seeks a jury trial and has already seen summons issued for the defendant. This legal action highlights ongoing concerns regarding workplace equality and discrimination in the automotive industry.

properties.title: American Axle & Manufacturing Faces Jury Trial Over Racial Discrimination Lawsuit
properties.summary: American Axle & Manufacturing faces a serious civil rights lawsuit filed by Jessica LaRoque, alleging racial discrimination in the workplace. The case, initiated on September 10, 2025, in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan, demands a jury trial, highlighting the gravity of the accusations against the company.

properties.summary: American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings has successfully acquired Dowlais for $1.4 billion and is now listed on the London Stock Exchange. This strategic move aims to enhance growth through cost synergies and establish a leadership position in the electric vehicle market while diversifying its geopolitical footprint.

properties.title: American Axle Faces Legal Scrutiny Over $1.4 Billion Dowlais Acquisition Amid Antitrust Concerns
properties.summary: American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings is facing scrutiny over its $1.4 billion acquisition of Dowlais Group plc, with multiple law firms investigating potential breaches of fiduciary duties and the adequacy of merger terms for shareholder protection. The merger, which includes a secondary listing in London, aims to generate $300 million in annual cost savings and strengthen the company's position in the evolving automotive market, particularly in the transition to electric vehicles. Additionally, regulatory concerns in Brazil regarding antitrust issues could impact the company's operations.

properties.summary: Timothy Blockett has initiated a new legal action against American Axle & Manufacturing, Inc., claiming violations of labor laws. properties.title: Vanguard Group Increases Stake in American Axle to Over 8%
properties.summary: The Vanguard Group has significantly increased its stake in American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings, now holding over 8% of the company's shares. This increase from approximately 4.83% to 8.14% as of October 2, 2023, marks a notable development in the company's shareholder landscape.

properties.title: Regulatory Scrutiny Intensifies Over American Axle's Mergers in Germany and India
properties.summary: American Axle & Manufacturing faces scrutiny over its acquisition of bankrupt competitor Mitec in Germany, raising competition concerns. In India, the Competition Commission is actively seeking public opinion on AAM's proposed merger with Bharat Forge Limited, reflecting heightened regulatory vigilance regarding potential anti-competitive effects in the axle manufacturing sector.

properties.title: CCI Opens Public Consultation on Bharat Forge and AAM Merger Concerns
properties.summary: The Competition Commission of India (CCI) has initiated a public consultation regarding the proposed merger between Bharat Forge Limited and AAM India Manufacturing Corporation, citing potential risks to competition in the commercial vehicle axle sector. Stakeholders and the public are invited to provide feedback during a ten-day consultation period, as the merger could lead to a dominant market player and higher prices.

properties.title: American Axle's Legal Battle Continues as Supreme Court Declines Appeal on Patent Ruling
properties.summary: American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings faces ongoing legal challenges after the U.S. Supreme Court declined to hear its appeal regarding a patent for noise-reducing driveshaft technology. The Federal Circuit's ruling has prompted discussions on patent eligibility standards, with some claims against AAM being allowed to proceed while others were dismissed for lack of specificity, indicating a mixed outcome for the company.

properties.title: American Axle's Merger with Dowlais Clears Antitrust Hurdle
properties.summary: American Axle & Manufacturing has received clearance for its $1.44 billion acquisition of Dowlais as the antitrust waiting period has expired. This development allows the merger process to move forward without additional regulatory hurdles, with the deal expected to close in the fourth quarter of the year, pending final conditions.

properties.title: Court Ruling on Neapco vs. AAM: Mixed Outcomes for Patent Claims
properties.summary: The court's recent ruling on Neapco's allegations against AAM has resulted in a mixed outcome, with some claims of patent infringement surviving while others were dismissed due to insufficient factual support. This decision highlights the importance of specificity in legal complaints, as the court emphasized the need for adequate details to support claims. Neapco's ability to plead certain claims successfully indicates a potential path forward in the ongoing legal battle.

properties.title: Man Group PLC Increases Short Positions in American Axle
properties.summary: Man Group PLC has revealed a significant increase in its short positions in American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings Inc., with a notable short position of 268,059 shares through equity swaps. properties.title: Man Group PLC Reveals Investment in American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings
properties.summary: On February 5, 2025, Man Group PLC disclosed its investment in American Axle & Manufacturing Holdings, Inc., revealing ownership of 91,450 common shares, which is about 0.08% of the total shares. This disclosure, made under the Takeover Code, also highlights their holding of 0.17% of the company's relevant securities through various interests and short positions, shedding light on their investment strategy and engagement with the company.

The investigations aim to ensure that the interests of AAM shareholders are adequately protected in the merger process.

properties.title: Court Partially Dismisses Induced Infringement Claims Against Neapco
properties.summary: The court has partially granted AAM's motion to dismiss, specifically dismissing the induced infringement claims against Neapco due to insufficient allegations regarding pre-suit knowledge of the patents. Additionally, the court stated that the determination of the scope of alleged infringement is not yet ripe for consideration.
